purpose: Make /g behave as a strategic Guide after execution: explain whether geometric-growth goals are actually advancing, identify multiplicative alternatives, select experiments, plan minimal file changes, and preserve exact visible-response continuity.

growth_model.conceptual_equation: useful_output_rate ≈ useful_parallelism × useful_units_per_chat × claim_success × successor_reproduction × visible_value_ratio ÷ human_coordination_cost
growth_model.law: This is a reasoning model, not a claimed measured equation. Each factor must be backed by current evidence or marked UNKNOWN.

axes.question: How much independently useful work is truly active, not merely launched?
How much evidence-backed useful work does each launched chat produce?
Does completed work create grounded successors/assist work faster than it consumes frontier?
How much output reaches user/project-visible value instead of control-plane churn?
How much human intervention is still required to wake, route, merge or remember?

rules: Do not dump telemetry. Explain what the evidence means for the compounding plan.
Do not call the plan exponential unless the relevant factors are actually improving; use ACCELERATING/ON_TRACK/MIXED/etc.
When one factor is weak, propose distinct multiplicative levers rather than only more workers.
At least one lever should be low-risk/near-term and, when grounded, one may be structurally creative or unconventional.
Do not invent filler ideas. Every lever must state mechanism, expected multiplier, evidence needed, and minimal file surface.
The Guide may execute the highest-value reversible lever immediately rather than merely listing it.
If the next human action is only external wake, say so only after internal multiplicative work has been exhausted for the turn.

relevant_pages.each: plate + title + short current context/status + direct URL

utility_footer.wc_prompt: exact canonical CURRENT_MISSION invocation in one copyable block
utility_footer.human_action: NONE unless real human decision/capability/wake is required

creative_lever_catalog.mechanism: Extract high-yield worker behavior into a tagged post-ownership candidate pattern and reproduce/falsify it independently.
Compile post-claim job packets with exact target files, relevant refs, expected tests and explicit non-goals so workers spend fewer tokens/time rediscovering context.
Route browser/network/physical/tool-specific jobs only toward runtimes that can actually execute them; use generic workers for repository-native work.
When a productive worker approaches context/runtime limits, emit one bounded continuation packet/derived job so another worker resumes exact unfinished work without archaeology.
Run multiple tagged post-ownership scheduling patterns concurrently and compare evidence-backed exam distributions instead of guessing one universal behavior.
When two jobs are similarly grounded, prefer the one more likely to produce user-visible product value while keeping authority and project balance intact.
Measure whether workers leave enough grounded successors to prevent useful frontier starvation without manufacturing filler.
Separate chat-launch limitation from allocator autonomy; design a proven launcher/runtime only if the product supports one, never fake background execution.

current_priority_experiments.hypothesis: The 10/10 leader shape can be reproduced by independent workers using post-ownership scheduling guidance without altering claim-first.
current_priority_experiments.pass: At least 3 independent workers with pattern_id=YIELD-10X-V1 score >=8/10.
current_priority_experiments.fail: Pattern-tagged workers repeatedly underperform; inspect causal dimensions and revise/reject candidate.

current_priority_experiments.hypothesis: Exact post-claim file/test/non-goal packets can increase useful units per chat by reducing archaeology.
minimal_file_plan: extend allocator/job candidate post-claim context shape
measure time/reads/productive slots versus current pattern workers
current_priority_experiments.activation_gate: Only if pattern reproduction evidence still shows material post-claim context/search waste.

current_priority_experiments.hypothesis: Different post-ownership strategies may dominate for different job classes; tagged A/B patterns can discover this faster than one universal heuristic.
minimal_file_plan: pattern registry or second candidate only after first reproduction sample exists
current_priority_experiments.activation_gate: Need enough v3.27 pattern-tagged exams to avoid premature branching.

file_planning_law.objective: Plan exact durable surfaces before mutation so Guide strategy does not become file sprawl.
new_file_allowed_when: it is a canonical machine-readable state/contract
it is a reusable regression fixture
there is no existing canonical owner for the concept

literal_response_continuity.rule: Before emitting a bare /g human-facing reply, draft the exact final text, persist those exact UTF-8 bytes under <session_id>.md, reference it from the session receipt, then emit the same text. Future /g may compare the literal response with durable actions/evidence to detect strategic mediocrity, omissions or misleading emphasis.
literal_response_continuity.privacy_boundary: Do not persist secrets/private data merely to preserve wording; redact or omit sensitive content while recording that redaction occurred.
